subject.title: [Feature]: Add channels.signal.linkPreview config and pass-through to signal-cli JSON-RPC send

question: Should Signal link-preview support be added as an explicit opt-in Signal plugin setting, and should it be top-level, per-account, or both?
rationale: The missing code path is clear, but the default behavior, linked-device failure mode, and untrusted metadata boundary are product/security choices rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add default-safe opt-in support
options.body: Add `channels.signal.linkPreview` with unset preserving current behavior, allow per-account override if maintainers want multi-account control, pass only explicit preview fields, and document primary-device limits.

options.title: Defer behind security design
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/22060 settles the broader link-preview metadata boundary, then implement Signal support with that policy.

options.title: Default-on support
options.body: Enable Signal link previews by default with an escape hatch, accepting the higher upgrade and security review burden.

recommendation.title: Add default-safe opt-in support
recommendation.body: Add `channels.signal.linkPreview` with unset preserving current behavior, allow per-account override if maintainers want multi-account control, pass only explicit preview fields, and document primary-device limits.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on Signal send/config/docs surfaces and already added relevant maintainer-facing context on this issue.
